digest.component_or_area: store lock management and compaction sweep
propositions: A blocked writer cannot identify when a compaction sweep holds the store write lock, only seeing a bare pid and no information about whether it is safe to interrupt

The compaction sweep is interruptible without data loss because skipped sweeps are no-ops and the next trigger re-folds events, but this guarantee is not communicated to operators in lock timeout errors
Lock timeout messages must include an operation label (op=compact-sweep) in the lock owner stamp so blocked writers can identify compaction sweeps as the holder
The LockTimeout error message must include remedy text stating that a compaction sweep holder is safe to interrupt and loses no data, appearing only for labeled interruptible operations
